spec.structural_change:
REFILL-2/S81 (10-21) parallel fallbacks of dsdv_sh_lk_s10g / s10h: k-means regional CTS (clock_split_km.tcl).

Why: the s10g / s10h --cts gates (10-21 04:25 / 04:36) FAILED only clock_rule: 14,318 sinks on one TritonCTS root,
pin-flop spread TT 147.2 / FF 129.9 ps (s10g) and TT 171.4 / FF 146.2 ps (s10h) > 80.  Fix (same recipe that took the
COLL lanes s8n 121.6 -> s8nk 83 ps): split the ck port net into K compact sink clusters with one local root each under a
balanced top tree.  q = K 24, r = K 32.  Same RTL, outline, macros, pins, PDN, layer contract and cycles.

--- s10g base ---
S81-SHLK-1021 successor of s10f (route b0972fda0 FAIL: daemon sign-off TT +13.8 / FF hold -20.6 on 31 pins / DRC 19 M4 shorts; the ORFS raw -273 ps / 1449 hold paths is the unreferenced 166.7-ps input min-delay against ~450 ps propagated insertion, not the judged number). All 19 shorts sit on the MY-mirrored left-column macros' centre-facing pin face (x = edge - 0.5..1.5 um, M4): the m1 masters carry ~10 pins/um on their 39-44-um side faces (> SAFE 6/um), so the router jogs inside the 1-um OBS gap. Fix: Codex p192 contact-pitch masters (accd38c70; same behaviour/bodies, 0.192-um pin pitch = 5.2 pins/um, 76.968 / 86.136 um tall; PG straps pulled back 1.5 um as the _pa views) selected by OT_S81_SH_P192 (default off, no RTL behaviour change, no added cycle), outline grown for the taller macros, hold repair margin 30 -> 60 ps. S81-SHLK-1021 s10g: 3 rows x 2 columns of p192 masters (16x289 99.1x86.1 row 1, 16x257 89.4x77.0 rows 2-3; 44,618 um2) at x 43.2 (MY) / 216.0 (R0), y 43.2 / 172.8 / 302.4: 73.7-83.4-um centre channel, 43.5 / 52.6-um row channels, 52.6-um N band; outline 345.6 x 432 (149,299 um2, fill ~37% with ~10k std).

reroute_reason.note: structural successor of dsdv_sh_lk_s10f (route b0972fda0 FAIL DRC19 M4 shorts at ~10 pins/um macro faces + FF hold -20.6): p192 masters, taller outline, hold margin 60
